name: change-review
title: Change review record
for_each: select id,code from changes order by code

sections.title: Impact and recovery
sections.sql: select v.specification->>'impact' as impact,v.specification->>'recovery' as recovery,v.digest from versions v join changes c on c.id=v.change_id and c.version=v.version where c.id=$1

sections.title: Rehearsal evidence
sections.sql: select v.version,r.operator,r.passed,r.result->>'stage' as failed_stage,r.created_at from rehearsals r join versions v on v.id=r.version_id where v.change_id=$1 order by r.created_at
sections.note: A passing rehearsal covers the supplied fixture only. Full machine results are retained in the database.

name: release-evidence
title: Release evidence pack
for_each: select id,code from changes order by code

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select v.version,a.reviewer,a.decision,a.evidence,a.created_at from approvals a join versions v on v.id=a.version_id where v.change_id=$1 order by a.created_at

sections.title: Deployment outcomes recorded by operators
sections.sql: select v.version,d.outcome,d.evidence,d.operator,d.created_at from deployments d join versions v on v.id=d.version_id where v.change_id=$1 order by d.created_at

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: select note,operator,created_at from notes where change_id=$1 order by created_at
